The '''Slag Pit''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] and owned by [[Odrell Vorbaal]]<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>. Along with the [[Meltdown Café]] and [[The Burning Deck]], it was one of the moon's three most popular [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] hangouts.
